title: QP-Faith: a label-free audit for category mis-routing in LLM query planners
description: Benchmark, procedural probe generator, planner runners, and scoring and validation code for "Category Mis-Routing in LLM Query Planners: A Reproducible Failure Mode and a Label-Free Audit for E-commerce Search", Information Processing & Management (Elsevier), 2026. Contains a 1,217-query type-less probe, persisted plans for nine planners across six providers, the relevance-grounded harm protocol, and the human-evaluation materials. Source catalogs are not redistributed; WANDS and Amazon ESCI remain under their owners' terms.
